review_coverage: Real Request admission and externally fixed request/code/authority hashes; exact 18-month composite monthly binding, SessionClock, roots, contract and index.
Shared cumulative correction root compatible with the frozen FULL_H1 economic auditor; six disjoint replay roots and exact inventory union across phases.
Fresh MonthlyInputs for every phase/month; no source.used inheritance from replay into later correction.
Fixed global sequence lock, producer locks, explicit fresh/resume modes, complete-prefix revalidation and rejection of partial/receiptless/orphan artifacts.
Correction receipt SHA passed to replay; source/code rechecks and closure/output verification before immutable chained receipts.
Independent economic audit remains a separate action; wrapper success means pending audit, never economic PASS or policy selection.
Gate before admission/each phase; observed RSS boundaries, duration and distinct new/cumulative payload byte counts.

findings.problem: The original receipt omitted RSS and labelled cumulative inventory bytes without distinguishing new phase outputs.
findings.resolution: Receipts now contain rss_start_bytes/rss_end_bytes with rss_peak_measured=false, new_output_bytes and cumulative_output_bytes. The phase timer includes MonthlyInputs admission. Spec distinguishes payload bytes from physical I/O and excludes pipeline logs/receipts/locks.
findings.independent_evidence: Read the final timer/receipt/spec and checked first-phase positive RSS plus new_output_bytes == cumulative_output_bytes > 0 in the ad hoc synthetic boundary run.

findings.problem: An existing pipeline completion.json could be admitted with fewer than 12 completed receipts and allow new phases before its later rejection.
findings.resolution: completed_prefix now permits global completion only after all 12 phases and verifies its exact reconstructed payload before further work.
findings.independent_evidence: After a synthetic correction-only prefix, inserted premature completion and confirmed resume rejected it without creating another source or executing another phase. The author's full-completion corruption fixture was inspected but not rerun by this reviewer.

findings.problem: Historical realized output files were previously required to exist but were not compared with the hashes already sealed in calibration.training_records before receipt publication.
findings.resolution: correction_closure now verifies each record_sha256, exact history membership and identity/selection/model/prediction/labels/availability bindings before the replay-enabling receipt.
findings.independent_evidence: Reran the fixture mutating realized after the producer closure and before the receipt: it rejects the mutation, publishes no phase receipt/global success, and rejects receiptless resume.
